attemptHistory.explanation: The test fetches the text content of '#result' immediately after clicking the button using 'page.textContent()', which does not wait for asynchronous DOM updates to finish. Because the data population occurs asynchronously after the click, the test reads an empty string before the text 'Data Loaded' is rendered.

confidence.reason: The failure log directly shows an empty string received immediately after click due to missing auto-retry mechanisms on page.textContent.

candidates.rationale: Replaces 'page.textContent()' and standard Jest-style 'expect().toBe()' with Playwright's web-first 'expect(locator).toHaveText()' assertion, which automatically retries and waits until the target element contains the expected text or times out.
Uses 'page.waitForFunction()' to explicitly pause test execution until the DOM node's text content updates to 'Data Loaded' before reading the value into memory.
